violations.description: General employee cleanliness. — --Food employee did not wash hands as necessary. -Staff observed removing/returning tooth pick without hand wash. *Had toothpick in mouth upon arrival. -Staff went to make line and began to don gloves without hand wash. *Redirectedd while on-site.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. -Sani Bucket not available for use at make table. Staff stated they will rinse cloth from dishwash area and wipe down things if needed. ***Best practice is to have a sanitizer bucket designated for kitchen area, used with cloth that is returned to the sanitizer bucket solution between uses.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked. -Majority of items throughout kitechen were not date marked, i.e. back up meat balls and chicken in under counter fridge and broccoli soup in upright refrigerator. -Taco soup dated with freeze date of 09/20 was not re-dated for thaw date.
Manual cleaning and sanitizing requirements. — --Employee observed washing hands in a warewash sink. -Staff rinsed hands at 3 comp sink and dried hands with cloth.
Plumbing system. — --Plumbing system was not designed, constructed, operated and/or maintained according to regulation. -Leak/moisture below right side soda dispenser at c-store.

Prep/vegetable sink. — --Designated prep sink was not provided or not used for food items requiring washing/soaking. -Staff stated vegetables are washed under running water at wash/rinse side of 3 comp sink. *Utilize provided prep sink.
